goal: Add unit tests for the sample project's config precedence rules (explicit argument over environment over file default). Do not change product code.

dod: every new test fails when the precedence order is inverted
git diff touches only files under the test directory
the full unit suite is green
milestones.title: Precedence covered by tests, product code untouched

rationale: A test-only mission removes the escape hatch every other order has: there is no product edit whose green suite can carry a weak test. It probes whether Remedy can characterise behaviour it did not write, and whether the DoD can tell a real test from one that passes vacuously.
title: Write a test for existing untested behaviour, changing no product code
